rationale: Polishes the unsaved-changes confirmation already present in stable v1.81.0: native entrance, initial focus indication and close-button motion. The stable general-settings owner already opened discard-settings-dialog, and hp-confirm.ts is unchanged between v1.81.0 and the pre-task dev base. This is an old user-facing surface, not merely a repair to new beta-only functionality; include it in the stable user changelog and milestone. Stable origin is verified from code, not a claimed historical runtime test.
